$playerId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['playerId', 'name', 'level', 'xp', 'score']) && newData.child('playerId').val() === $playerId && newData.child('level').isNumber() && newData.child('level').val() >= 1 && newData.child('level').val() <= 26 && newData.child('xp').isNumber() && newData.child('xp').val() >= 0 && newData.child('xp').val() <= 10000000 && newData.child('score').isNumber() && newData.child('score').val() >= 0 && newData.child('score').val() <= 16000000

progress..validate: !newData.exists() || (newData.child('coins').isNumber() && newData.child('coins').val() >= 0 && newData.child('coins').val() <= 5000000 && newData.child('gems').isNumber() && newData.child('gems').val() >= 0 && newData.child('gems').val() <= 100000 && newData.child('playerXp').isNumber() && newData.child('playerXp').val() >= 0 && newData.child('playerXp').val() <= 10000000 && newData.child('unlockedLevelMax').isNumber() && newData.child('unlockedLevelMax').val() >= 1 && newData.child('unlockedLevelMax').val() <= 26)
